title: IBM Jazz L1, L2 Support
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
--------------------


We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.


Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.

 **We are looking for an ALM Tools Administrator / Application Support Engineer.**

### **You’ll make a difference by:**

* Managing and supporting ALM tools infrastructure, preferably IBM Jazz, including installation, setup, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance.
* Supporting IBM Jazz ALM workflows and implementing necessary customizations to meet project and business requirements.
* Administering Windows Servers, including configuration, monitoring, patch management, and troubleshooting for ALM applications and associated tools.
* Managing and maintaining SQL Server databases supporting enterprise applications, ensuring performance, reliability, and data integrity.
* Ensuring high availability, system stability, backup, and recovery mechanisms for critical application environments.
* Providing L1 and L2 support for incidents, service requests, and change management activities while meeting defined SLA commitments.
* Supporting multiple users and project teams across different geographical locations and ensuring seamless tool availability.
* Coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders including development teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, project managers, and business users.
* Participating in system monitoring, root cause analysis, problem management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Preparing and maintaining technical documentation, support procedures, and operational guidelines.

### **You’ll win us over by:**

* Having an Engineering degree with **4\-8 years of demonstrable experience** in Application Administration, ALM Tools Management, or Enterprise Application Support.
* Possessing strong expertise in **IBM Jazz Platform**, including administration, configuration, workflow management, and customization.
* Having hands\-on experience in **Windows Server Administration**, server patching, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrating solid knowledge of **SQL Server Administration**, database management, backup, recovery, and performance monitoring.
* Showing a good understanding of **High Availability, Disaster Recovery, and System Reliability** concepts.
* Having experience in **Incident Management, Change Management, and Service Management Processes**.
* Being capable of supporting global users and collaborating with distributed teams across multiple locations.
* Demonstrating excellent stakeholder management, communication, and coordination skills.
* We give preference to candidates with experience in:
* IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (ELM/Jazz)
* ITIL Processes
* Application Monitoring Tools
* Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Batch Scripts, etc.)
* Azure DevOps or other ALM platforms

### **We’ll support you with:**

* Hybrid working opportunities.
* Diverse and inclusive culture.
* Great variety of learning and development opportunities.
* Attractive compensation package.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and cutting\-edge engineering tools.

**Join us and be yourself!**
----------------------------

  

This role is based in **Pune**, where you'll get the chance to work with global teams and contribute to engineering excellence through enterprise\-scale application lifecycle management platforms.


We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.


We're Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

**Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.**

description:
### **Job Title**


Item Masterdata Administrator### **Job Description**

**Item Masterdata Administrator \| Pune \| Full\-time**


Would you like to progress your career in a dynamic team that is key to the success of the organization?


We’ll give you the opportunity to work in an international environment with a team of talented and dedicated people. You will be in a position where you can improve your repeating daily work processes, to better support the Global Supply Chain and enhance the overall item masterdata quality.

 **What you will do**

 **Role \& Responsibilities:**


As Item Administrator you play a key role within Vanderlande’s global business. As a Item Administrator, you initiate the process and enable the organization to sell parts. You make sure the business is supported by proactively inquiring and managing commercial \& logistical information of suppliers like supplier lead time prices quantities Transportation mode etc.


Your strong analytical skills, and ability to set priorities and take decisions are crucial for achieving your goals. You will work closely with suppliers worldwide.


Furthermore, you excel at:

* Accuracy in your work and systematic thinking in routine tasks and data quality improvements.
* Improving processes and tooling from conceptual design to detailed execution
* Your interpersonal and communication skills, you are able to build relationships based on trust, persuasiveness and impact.
* Teamwork, aiming for quality, but with respect for local cultures. You ensure that your colleagues can depend on a steady, high\-quality data management process, by taking initiative and keeping the overview.
* Decision taking in order to assure process flow.

 **What you bring**

Maintenance of item master data (MDM), (Supplier, lead time, prices and quantities) Analyzing the data, Price maintenance, Supply chain, BOM, Change management, Advance Excel, Communication, ERP (JDE Edwards preferred)

 **Other Skills**

* Total experience required is 5 \+ year in Product/Master data management.
* Customer focus, Communication \& Presentation, Time Management, Co\-ordination, analytically strong mind.
* Excellent technical understanding, logical and tactical thinking skills, Dedicated \& responsible team player.

 **About Vanderlande:**


Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey: from check\-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.


At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

 **Website:** www.vanderlande.com

 **What we offer:**


Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice:

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro\-rated from the start of the financial year), including:


 \- 22 paid leave days.


 \- 8 Sick leave days


 \- Applicable government holidays.

* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work\-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

 **How we work**


We work by three values: Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.

 **Ready to apply?**


Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

 **Diversity \& inclusion**


Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: GIS Data Administrator
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.


Grow with the best. Join Stantec's globally connected Practice Technology Services Group (PTSG) in IT, a collaborative team responsible for delivering and managing many of the advanced technologies, resources, and vendor services that underpin project delivery across the company. Working at the intersection of business, technology, and operations, PTSG helps ensure critical digital platforms remain reliable, performant, and effectively supported for teams delivering value to clients across all business lines and regions.


Your Opportunity


This position focuses on the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise geospatial data and related Esri services. Working with authoritative datasets, enterprise geodatabases, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Pro, you will help ensure geospatial information is secure, reliable, compliant, and effectively managed by the business throughout its lifecycle. By supporting geospatial data governance, platform administration, and operational controls, you will contribute to the quality, resilience, and long\-term sustainability of Stantec’s enterprise GIS environment.


Your Key Responsibilities


* Analyze GIS platform performance, usage patterns, and service trends to identify issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.


* Contribute to GIS data governance standards and practices, and monitor, assess, and report on compliance \- metadata, data quality, lifecycle management, access controls, and information security practices.


* Evaluate the quality, integrity, and consistency of enterprise geospatial data, with a focus on authoritative datasets and sustainable data management practices.


* Administer and support ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and related Esri services in accordance with established operational procedures.


* Respond to and help manage Esri\-related incidents, service requests, licensing, and administrative activities through ServiceNow in a timely and effective manner.


* Analyze, investigate, and resolve Esri software and service issues and liaise with Esri support and stakeholders as required to identify root causes and appropriate resolutions.


Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Strong knowledge of GIS principles and geospatial data management in desktop, server, and online environments.


* Strong working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and related Microsoft and SQL Server technologies – to the extent needed to fulfill this role.


* Experience with the use and management of geospatial data in file\-based and database formats.


* Understanding of GIS data governance, metadata, data quality, lifecycle management, access controls, and information security practices.


* Strong analytical, organizational, decision\-making, problem\-solving, and workload management skills.


* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across globally distributed teams.


* Experience supporting enterprise Esri platforms and related GIS infrastructure is an asset.


* Experience leading people, service delivery activities, project teams, or technical workstreams is an asset.


* Familiarity with ServiceNow, work management platforms, reporting tools, and related technology solutions is an asset.


Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Minimum 5 years of practical GIS experience.


* Experience performing GIS analysis and working with diverse geospatial data types, including remote sensing products.


* Experience with GIS data backup, recovery, and resiliency practices is an asset.


Work / Environment


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this role. Duties and responsibilities may change over time to meet evolving business needs.


This role is part of a globally distributed team supporting enterprise technology services across Stantec's business. Success in the position requires effective collaboration across regions, time zones, and service areas, with occasional flexibility needed to support service transitions, operational priorities, and critical business activities.


Why Join Us?


As part of PTSG, you will have the opportunity to influence how enterprise GIS data, Esri technologies, and operational services are governed, supported, and delivered across a global organization. From strengthening geospatial data governance, quality practices, and operational support, this role offers the chance to contribute to technology services with broad organizational impact.


Join a collaborative team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth while helping deliver the digital capabilities that power Stantec's global business.

title: Salesforce Release Manager with Gearset /Copado experience- 5-8 Years – Pune
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an InP \- ITIL Release \& Deployment Management Analyst Senior to join our ever\-evolving Enterprise Operations Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

**What you’ll own**

We are seeking an experienced Release Manager to join our Enterprise Operations team, responsible for planning, coordinating, and governing Salesforce platform releases across Enterprise (LOB). This role is critical in ensuring changes are delivered safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to business operations while maintaining a high standard of quality, compliance, and operational stability.


You will work closely with product teams, developers, administrators, architects, engineers, business analysts, testing teams, and business stakeholders to manage the end\-to\-end release lifecycle across the Salesforce ecosystem. This includes coordinating deployments, managing release schedules, overseeing change control processes, mitigating release risk, and driving continuous improvement in release management practices.


As the central point of coordination for platform changes, you will ensure that Salesforce releases are planned, tested, approved, communicated, and successfully deployed in alignment with enterprise governance standards.

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end Salesforce release lifecycle across multiple products, teams, and environments.
* Develop and maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, and release roadmaps across the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Coordinate release activities across Salesforce Core, Agentforce, Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, integrations, and supporting platforms.
* Facilitate release planning, go/no\-go decisions, deployment readiness reviews, and release governance forums.
* Manage change control processes, ensuring all changes are appropriately assessed, approved, documented, and communicated.
* Coordinate dependencies across development, testing, business readiness, infrastructure, and operational support teams.
* Drive release risk management, identifying potential conflicts, issues, and deployment impacts before production implementation.
* Partner with engineering teams to support CI/CD adoption and automation of deployment processes.
* Ensure comprehensive release documentation, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and implementation records are maintained.
* Support testing coordination, including system integration testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment validation activities.
* Lead production deployment activities and act as the central point of coordination during release events.
* Monitor release outcomes, deployment success metrics, and post\-release performance to drive continuous improvement.
* Manage communication plans to ensure stakeholders are informed of release schedules, impacts, outages, and business readiness activities.
* Coordinate incident resolution and rollback activities when required following production deployments.
* Ensure releases comply with enterprise governance, security, audit, and regulatory requirements

**What you bring**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in Release Management, Change Management, or Delivery Management within enterprise technology environments.
* Experience managing releases across Salesforce environments including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce deployment processes, environment management, and release best practices.
* Experience working with:
* Salesforce DevOps processes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git\-based source control
* Automated deployment tools
* Environment strategy and management
* Experience coordinating complex releases involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and technology platforms.
* Strong knowledge of change management, risk management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools such as:
* Copado
* Gearset
* Salesforce DevOps Center
* AutoRABIT
* Azure DevOps
* Understanding of testing lifecycle activities including SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release validation.
* Experience managing release schedules, dependencies, and production deployment activities within Agile delivery environments.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe Agile.
* Excellent organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to coordinate senior business and technology leaders during major releases.
* Proven problem\-solving skills with the ability to remain calm and decisive during critical deployment activities.
* ITIL Change Management certification or equivalent experience is highly desirable.
* Salesforce certifications or experience within Salesforce platform delivery teams would be beneficial

**About the team**


Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. title: Senior Manager, IT Program Management
description:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we're dedicated to developing ground\-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting\-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient\-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.


The Anaplan Center of Excellence ( CoE ) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. As Sr. Project Manager, you will orchestrate the delivery of new applications and the continuous enhancement of the existing portfolio, working with a globally distributed team of developers and administrators and with business partners across multiple functions and time zones.


**How** **you'll** **make an impact:**

* Orchestrate a portfolio of concurrent Anaplan initiatives – new application builds and enhancement/update releases – across multiple use case families (e.g., financial planning \& analysis, commercial and sales planning, operational planning), balancing priorities, dependencies, and shared resources across 50\+ applications.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: intake and business case, detailed requirements definition, scoping, planning, build coordination, testing/UAT, deployment, and hypercare , using a hybrid delivery methodology (Agile sprints for build, stage\-gate/Waterfall controls for planning and release).
* Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of a distributed CoE team – 8–11 Anaplan developers in Pune and administrator resources in Prague and the US – without direct people\-management responsibility: plan sprints and releases, remove blockers, manage capacity and sequencing across projects.
* Partner with the enterprise data team on data integration requirements, source availability, and interface timelines; align delivery plans with data pipeline readiness.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.
* Maintain the CoE delivery roadmap and release calendar; manage changes to scope, schedule, and cost so plans remain accurate and reflect authorized changes.
* Actively manage project risks and issues; monitor performance, identify and quantify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Facilitate creation and approval of business cases and prioritization decisions, using historical data and expert judgment to understand constraints.
* Strengthen CoE delivery governance: standardize intake, estimation, status reporting, and release management practices; lead continuous improvement of PM processes within the CoE .
* Manage project closure activities, including lessons learned, and drive resulting improvements into future releases.
* Serve as a project management subject matter expert within the CoE ; guide and mentor team members on delivery practices.
* Other incidental duties.
**What** **you'll** **need (Required):**

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* A minimum of eight years of hands\-on experience managing software delivery projects of increasing complexity, or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria.
* Project Management Professional (PMP); if not, Green Belt, Black Belt, or Scrum Master certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery with globally distributed teams and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
* Experience running hybrid delivery models (Agile/Scrum combined with Waterfall/stage\-gate governance).
* This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, working second shift with overlap to European (CET) and partial US working hours.
**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience delivering Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / connected planning implementations on any platform (e.g., Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud/BPC, OneStream, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment).
* Understanding of planning processes in finance (budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning) and/or commercial functions (sales forecasting, quota and territory planning).
* Experience working alongside data engineering teams on integrations (ETL/ELT, APIs, data hubs).
* Demonstrated experience with SDLC project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps) and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet).
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and related project management systems.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives .
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent understanding of and work experience with project budgets and financial management .
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry.
